New Shingle Roof Installation Walnut Creek | ROOF EXPRESS 

Professional Asphalt Shingle Roofing in Walnut Creek, CA

If you're planning a new shingle roof installation in Walnut Creek, you need a roofing system that can handle the area’s hot summers, dry climate, and seasonal rain. At ROOF EXPRESS, we install high-performance asphalt shingle roofs built for durability, energy efficiency, and long-term protection.

As a Diamond Certified roofing company and GAF Certified Installer, we provide expert roofing solutions for homeowners across Walnut Creek and surrounding Contra Costa County.

Why Shingle Roofing is Ideal for Walnut Creek Homes

Walnut Creek’s inland climate makes asphalt shingles one of the best roofing choices:

Excellent heat resistance for hot summer temperatures

Affordable installation compared to tile or metal roofing

Wide variety of colors and styles

Strong durability against UV exposure and weather changes

Easy maintenance and repairs

With professional installation, your shingle roof can last 20–30+ years in Walnut Creek conditions.

Our Shingle Roof Installation Process

At ROOF EXPRESS, we follow a complete and code-compliant roofing process:

1. Roof Inspection & Planning

We evaluate your roof structure, attic ventilation, and existing materials.

2. Tear-Off & Deck Preparation

Old shingles are removed, and we inspect the wood decking for any damage.

3. Waterproofing System Installation

We install synthetic underlayment and leak barriers in critical areas like valleys and eaves.

4. Shingle Installation

We install premium architectural shingles from top brands like GAF and CertainTeed.

5. Final Inspection & Cleanup

We ensure everything meets our quality standards and leave your property spotless.

Best Shingle Options for Walnut Creek Climate

Due to Walnut Creek’s high summer temperatures, we recommend:

Cool Roof Shingles – Reflect sunlight and reduce heat buildup

Architectural Shingles – Enhanced durability and curb appeal

High-Performance Shingles – Longer lifespan under strong UV exposure

Our experts help you choose the right material based on your home’s design and exposure.

Signs You Need a New Shingle Roof

If you notice any of the following, it may be time for a replacement:

Cracked, curling, or missing shingles

Roof age over 20 years

Leaks or interior water stains

Excessive granule loss

Uneven or sagging roof areas

Don’t wait—early replacement can prevent costly structural damage.

Why Homeowners Choose ROOF EXPRESS in Walnut Creek

ROOF EXPRESS is trusted throughout the Bay Area because we offer:

Diamond Certified quality workmanship

GAF Certified roofing systems

Honest pricing with no hidden costs

Fast, efficient project completion

Clean and professional job sites

We understand Walnut Creek homes and build roofs that last.
